briefing.headline: The Gameweek 11 deadline is Saturday 21 November at 11:00 UTC, and transfers are moving toward N. Jackson, while João Pedro and Gvardiol are being sold.

points.text: Gameweek 11 deadline is 21 November 2026 at 11:00 UTC.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: Most bought this week: N. Jackson, Evanilson, Barry, Van Hecke and Vuskovic.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: Most sold this week: João Pedro, Gvardiol, Guéhi, Calvert-Lewin and Thiago.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: João Pedro has a thigh injury with an unknown return date. Gvardiol, Virgil, Guéhi, Belloumi and Manzambi are each rated 75% to play.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: Price rises: Gabriel, Rice, Konsa, N. Jackson and Tavernier. Price falls: Saka, Madjo, Cook, Brooks and Schade.
points.label: confirmed
